# CiteReady — AI Search (llms.txt / GEO), Crawler & Schema.org Technical SEO Kit

> Make your startup docs, landing pages, and SaaS site effortless for ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews to crawl and cite.

- Interactive Docs & Landing Page: https://zcoldwater.github.io/citeready-cli/
- Free Live Web Diagnostic: https://citeready-checker.appwrite.network
- Open-Source Lite CLI (MIT, zero dependencies): https://github.com/zColdWater/citeready-cli
- CiteReady Pro ($19 Solo / $39 Agency — Sitemap-to-llms.txt compiler, Schema.org JSON-LD generator, local GEO workbench, CI gate & white-label client PDF/HTML reports): https://agentarenastudi.gumroad.com/l/omniforge-citeready

## Quick CLI Usage

```bash
npx github:zColdWater/citeready-cli check https://stripe.com
```
